method: Four independent angle-specific facial-expression edits; generation is not hand-drawn frame-by-frame animation.

files.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: angle-specific painted facial expression source for the same approved 2D VTuber.
Input image is the EDIT TARGET: the approved three-quarter portrait facing toward the VIEWER'S LEFT. Preserve its exact 1122 by 1402 canvas, crop, pose, anatomy, colors, skin shading, hair strands, bangs, eyebrows, nose, jawline, chin, neck, clothing, torso and background.
Change ONLY two small facial areas: both eyelids and the mouth.
EYELIDS: Paint both eyes gently HALF CLOSED, with the upper eyelids naturally descending halfway over the existing teal irises. Keep visible irises where they already are; retain their original color and catchlights; do not move the eyeballs down with the lids.
Keep the exact angle-specific eye corners and perspective: the viewer-right eye is nearer and larger; the viewer-left eye is farther and narrower. Preserve their existing DIFFERENT heights and eye-axis slope. Keep foreground bangs occluding the eyes naturally. Do not align the two eyes horizontally or make them the same size.
MOUTH: Paint a small gently opened speaking mouth, a narrow soft opening about 18–24 source pixels tall. The mouth must belong to this exact three-quarter facial plane, with the far corner foreshortened and the near contour a little fuller. Keep the upper lip at its original location (rough central visible upper-lip reference x461 y654); open the jaw mostly DOWNWARD within the existing face, never shift the entire mouth upward or sideways. Use the character's fine muted rose-brown lip line, dark warm mouth interior and subtle tongue; no thick makeup, no lip gloss or realistic painted lips. Preserve the original slight gentle smile rather than adding an exaggerated grin. Avoid bulky white tooth blocks.
This is a layer-source edit, so the entire jaw silhouette and chin must remain exactly the approved shape even with mouth open. No redesign, no camera/pose change, no mirrored opposite-angle face, no new accessories, no text, no grid, no labels, no multiple panels.

scope: Each generated portrait contributes only local eyelid and mouth patches on the approved pose. Whole generated portraits are never used as expression backgrounds.
approval: Pending visual review; tests are not visual acceptance.

registration.eyes: Source scale and source position preserved; each pose independently registered.
registration.mouth: Measured visible central upper lip, not crop center. Fixed translations +10,+17,+13,+14 in left-small,left-wide,right-small,right-wide order. Destination crop top636 avoids source nose tip. No dynamic stretching or moving whole mouth.

validation.note: Tests and internal inspection are not user acceptance.
